essence: The Lord's renewed teaching is motivated by care for Arjuna's welfare.
The Lord's origin remains unknown to gods and sages because he is their beginning.
Knowing the Lord as world-lord frees the undeluded mortal from all sins.
The verse enumerates qualities and states that arise from the Lord.
The listed states of beings arise in various kinds from the Lord alone.
